q: What is the minimum password length at Nimbus?
answer: At least 14 characters, and MFA is mandatory on every account.

q: After how many minutes of inactivity must a Nimbus laptop screen lock?
answer: Screens auto-lock after 5 minutes of inactivity; the setting is enforced.

q: Where should I forward a suspicious email?
answer: Forward it to phish@nimbus.example.

q: What is the response time for a SEV1 incident and who gets paged?
answer: SEV1 (customer-wide outage or confirmed breach of Confidential/Restricted data) needs a response within 15 minutes; the CISO and CTO are paged along with the incident commander.

q: Which class can I fly on a 10-hour international flight for work?
answer: Premium economy, because the flight time is above 8 hours (economy applies under 8 hours).

q: What is the daily allowance for business travel to a metro city in India?
answer: ₹3,500 per day (non-metro ₹2,500, international USD 75).

q: What are the default anchor days for office attendance?
answer: Tuesday and Wednesday, as part of the 3 office days a week requirement.

q: Independence Day 2026 falls on a Saturday. Is there still a flag-hoisting at the office?
answer: Yes, a flag-hoisting ceremony is held at each office at 8:30 am on Saturday, 15 August 2026; attendance is voluntary and the day is not counted in the 12 holidays.

q: What is the group term life insurance cover for employees?
answer: 3 times annual fixed pay, with a minimum of ₹20 lakh, paid by Nimbus.

q: Within how many hours must CERT-In be notified of a reportable cyber incident?
answer: Within 6 hours of the incident being noticed.

q: What happens to earned leave above the carry-forward limit at year end?
answer: Up to 30 days of EL carry forward; anything beyond 30 days lapses on 31 March.

q: If a Principal (L6) resigns, how long is the notice period and when is the full and final settlement paid?
answer: L6 and above serve 90 days' notice; the full and final settlement is paid within 45 days of the last working day, after clearance.

q: What referral bonus does an employee get for referring a Senior Software Engineer (L3)?
answer: ₹60,000, paid after the hire completes 90 days of service (plus ₹25,000 if it is a hot-skill role).

q: Can recruitment agencies be used for any role, and what fee is allowed?
answer: Only for L4 and above or hot-skill roles, with the fee capped at 8.33% of first-year fixed pay.

q: What is the salary band for a Tech Lead (L4)?
answer: ₹18–28 lakh per annum fixed pay (midpoint ₹23 lakh).

q: When is the FY2026-27 variable pay paid out?
answer: In the July 2027 payroll, after audited results and ratings are final.

q: How long does a formal Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) last?
answer: 60 days, which may be extended once by up to 30 days, with documented reviews every 2 weeks.

q: Can employees bring their pets to the Nimbus office?

q: What RPO and RTO were measured in the April 2026 full DR drill, and did it pass?
answer: The 18 April 2026 full drill measured RPO 6 minutes and RTO 47 minutes and passed.

q: What is the API rate limit per key for Enterprise-plan customers?
answer: 600 requests per minute per API key, with a burst of 100.

q: Who can accept the risk of a Critical vulnerability that cannot be fixed within SLA, and for how long?
answer: The CISO and CTO jointly, for a maximum exception period of 30 days.

q: Why must infrastructure and system logs be kept for at least 180 days?
answer: To meet the CERT-In Directions of April 2022, which require ICT system logs to be kept securely within India for a rolling 180 days.

q: Who must approve new recurring cloud spend above ₹5 lakh per month?
answer: The Head of Infrastructure & SRE (above ₹25 lakh per month, the CFO).

q: Who approves a discount of more than 10% and up to 15% of total contract value?

answer: ₹10–18 lakh per annum fixed.

answer: In India: AWS ap-south-1 (Mumbai), with disaster recovery in ap-south-2 (Hyderabad); it is never replicated outside India.
